item.title: State Capitalism and Entrepreneurs in an International Setting
item.content:encoded:
David Ahlstrom, Hong Kong Metropolitan University

Jiatao Li, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

Bin Liu, Xiamen University

Gongming Qian, Shantou University

This collection examines how different forms of state capitalism interact with entrepreneurship globally, particularly in the Asia Pacific region. It addresses the recent shift toward increased state involvement in enterprise after years of privatization and deregulation, exploring how this state capitalism manifests in varied ways across different regions and institutional contexts.

Appel publié par Asia Pacific Journal of Management. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Varieties of state capitalism and their relationships with entrepreneurship
  • State influence on enterprise in Asia Pacific regions and beyond
  • Entrepreneurship in established corporations with state influence
  • Creation and dynamics of hybrid state-private enterprises
  • Relations between new ventures and corporations with state influence
  • Institutional frameworks affecting entrepreneurship under state capitalism
  • Mechanisms through which varieties of state capitalism affect entrepreneurship
